scope: Finite selected DEVELOPMENT samples at one fixed board/bucket XY. Sampled capture runs and their extrema do not certify continuous success intervals. Current IK/staging failures are not proof of global impossibility. Paired timestep repetitions reuse the same23 requested configurations; they are not69 independent layouts. Robustness covers declared joint height/tilt/gap noise only, not all placement errors, actuator tracking or physical validity.
robustness_gate: At each specified timestep,3/3 nominal captures and>=18/20 fresh captures, counting rejected requests as failures; finite engineering observation, not probability certification
